svg.aria-label: Focale OS: Operations platform for medical congresses. EventTech · multi-tenant SaaS. Registration, abstracts and peer review, sponsorships, a rule-based pricing engine, certificates and check-in. Outbox worker, SSE realtime, concurrency-tested. Stack: Bun, Fastify, Prisma, CockroachDB, React. 806 commits, 440 test files, CI. Opens the focale-backend repository on GitHub.
